python3 << 'EOF'
import math
import numpy as np

# National Defense expenditures (in millions of dollars)
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301  # includes emergency ship construction from March 1941 per footnote
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
log_growth_rates = []
years = []
for year in range(1934, 1942):
    prev_year = year - 1
    log_growth = math.log(expenditures[year] / expenditures[prev_year])
    log_growth_rates.append(log_growth)
    years.append(year)
    print(f"{prev_year}-{year}: {expenditures[prev_year]} -> {expenditures[year]}: log growth = {log_growth:.6f}")

print("\nLog growth rates:", log_growth_rates)

# Calculate population standard deviation
mean = np.mean(log_growth_rates)
std_pop = np.std(log_growth_rates, ddof=0)  # population standard deviation

print(f"Mean log growth rate: {mean:.6f}")
print(f"Population std dev: {std_pop:.6f}")

# Coefficient of variation = std / mean
cv = std_pop / abs(mean)  # use absolute mean since growth rates are positive
print(f"Coefficient of variation: {cv:.6f}")

# Round to nearest hundredth
cv_rounded = round(cv, 2)
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {cv_rounded}")

EOF
